title: Transition.
bodyText: This chapter shall apply to a Canadian domestic-violence protection order issued before, on, or after June 17, 2022, and to a continuing action for enforcement of a Canadian domestic-violence protection order commenced before, on, or after June 17, 2022. A request for enforcement of a Canadian domestic-violence protection order made on or after June 17, 2022, for a violation of the order occurring before, on, or after June 17, 2022, shall be governed by this chapter.

annotations.heading: Revision Note
annotations.text: "June 17, 2022" and "June 17, 2022," respectively, substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.

bodyHtml:
[§586C-10]  Transition.  This chapter shall apply to a Canadian domestic-violence protection order issued before, on, or after June 17, 2022, and to a continuing action for enforcement of a Canadian domestic-violence protection order commenced before, on, or after June 17, 2022.  A request for enforcement of a Canadian domestic-violence protection order made on or after June 17, 2022, for a violation of the order occurring before, on, or after June 17, 2022, shall be governed by this chapter. [L 2022, c 107, pt of §1]

 

Revision Note

 

  "June 17, 2022" and "June 17, 2022," respectively, substituted for "the effective date of this chapter" pursuant to §23G-15.
